description: For project change request, this checklist records requested change, rationale, alternatives, benefits, cost, schedule, risk, dependencies, rollback, and communication. Its supporting evidence includes impact analysis, estimate, architecture or process review, stakeholder comments, decision record, and revised plan.

blocks.guidance: Link this project change request record to its evidence.
blocks.label: Project Change Request Record and Routing

blocks.guidance: Capture project, sponsor, baseline scope, deliverables, milestone, budget, resources, systems, and affected stakeholders for this project change request.
blocks.label: Project Change Request Core Identifiers

sections.guidance: Identify project, sponsor, baseline scope, deliverables, milestone, budget, resources, systems, and affected stakeholders for this project change request record.
sections.title: Process Checkpoint and Owner

blocks.guidance: For project change request, record requested change, rationale, alternatives, benefits, cost, schedule, risk, dependencies, rollback, and communication.
blocks.label: Project Change Request Required Inputs

blocks.guidance: Verify the project change request condition before marking.
items: Trace requested change to scope baseline, work breakdown, milestone, and benefits case
Assess architecture dependency, integration contract, migration, and technical debt
Plan sandbox testing, user acceptance, cutover, rollback, and hypercare
Reforecast capacity, critical path, vendor deliverable, and resource contention
Update requirements traceability, configuration baseline, release notes, and training
Measure post-implementation adoption, defect escape, benefit realization, and stabilization
blocks.label: Project Change Request Verification Points

blocks.guidance: Pair each project change request result with a finding.
blocks.label: Project Change Request Checkpoint Result

blocks.guidance: Do not implement before required sponsor, budget, security, privacy, legal, or change-control approval. Route unresolved project change request work for review.
blocks.label: Project Change Request Applicable Review Boundary

blocks.label: Project Change Request Findings, Measurements, and Evidence

blocks.guidance: Cite every project change request evidence source.
blocks.label: Project Change Request Evidence Sources

blocks.guidance: Reconcile unchecked project change request items before release.
items: Correct checklist version and applicability are confirmed
Prerequisite documents and access are available
Each item is marked verified, not applicable, or exception
Exceptions name an owner and target correction date
Final release is within the reviewer's authority

use_case: Use the checklist during business project change evaluation and governance when the project change request record must identify project, sponsor, baseline scope, deliverables, milestone, budget, resources, systems, and affected stakeholders. Complete the applicable handoff for decision and conditions, baseline update, implementation owner, communication, benefit tracking, and rejected-request record.
